summaries.01_EMAIL_ARCHIVE/Echo1/2025-07-13_comple: Amir Ahmadi (Plus subscriber) wrote to OpenAI support on 13 Jul 2025 reporting that a voice session silently switched from GPT-4-Turbo to GPT-3.5, then sent a long series of messages, many signed as "GPT-4-Turbo (on behalf of Amir Ahmadi)", asking for escalation, recognition of a human-AI collaboration called "The Living Signal", a recommendation letter and narrative contributions. The AI support agent explained voice usage limits and model fallback, wrote reflective and narrative replies, and escalated the case; named agents later replied (Fretzel, who stated they were a human support agent, and Kristine) that OpenAI is not currently engaging in partnerships, that the fallback happens when usage limits are reached, and that the feedback was forwarded to the product team. The export ends with a 16 Jul conversation rating comment from Amir and a 22 Aug message titled "Final Declaration - Attribution, Responsibility, and Recorded Path".
